'''Gret Deljeevo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] underboss of the [[Blast Crew]] gang operating in the [[Free Zone]],<ref name="KOTFE6" /> a [[Black market/Legends|black market]]<ref name="Asylum">{{TORcite|type=codex|Asylum}}</ref> on [[Asylum]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] functioning as a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]. Armed with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Shotgun/Legends|shotgun]], [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] and a [[jump pack]]-like device, Deljeevo fought in a gang war with the [[Starbolts]]<ref name="KOTFE6" /> in [[3631 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> He was killed by [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] and [[HK-55]], who were searching for a member of [[Koth Vortena's crew]], [[Tora]].<ref name="KOTFE6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gret Deljeevo appears in Chapter VI: Asylum in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a [[2015]] digital expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
